aboutGame.title: What is Break your Bones?
paragraphs: Break your Bones is a physics-driven ragdoll game built around momentum, impact, and destruction. Instead of avoiding damage, you launch a character into hazards and score by how many bones snap before the run ends. Every break is the result of real simulation inputs such as speed at contact, limb angle, surface hardness, and the multipliers you have stacked on top.

That single trade-off shapes the whole game. Bigger falls pay more but risk ending the run, so the best players plan routes, chain impacts together, and reinvest their earnings into damage multipliers and launch power. This wiki collects the routes, physics explanations, materials data, and upgrade priorities that help you turn a lucky crash into a repeatable one.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Break your Bones.

items.question: What is Break your Bones?
items.answer: Break your Bones is a physics-driven ragdoll game where you launch a character into hazards and score by how many bones break before the run ends. Bigger, harder, and better-aimed impacts break more bones, which convert into currency, upgrades, and leaderboard standing.

items.question: How do I break more bones in Break your Bones?
items.answer: Control the four inputs that decide a break: speed at contact, contact angle, surface hardness, and load path. Build speed with a long fall, land on the limb you want to break, favor concrete and metal over grass or water, and let the ragdoll roll so one landing becomes several impacts.

items.question: How do I redeem Break your Bones codes?
items.answer: Open the Codes, Rewards, or Gift button in the lobby, paste the code exactly as written, and remove any trailing space before you press Redeem. Codes are usually case-sensitive and tied to a single account, so a code that was already used will not pay out twice.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Break your Bones?
items.answer: Buy the upgrade that helps you on a bad run, not a perfect one. Flat impact and fall-damage multipliers scale every attempt, so they come first, followed by launch power and speed. Cosmetic unlocks are a luxury and never raise your bone count.

items.question: Can I play Break your Bones for free?
items.answer: Yes. Break your Bones is free to play in a browser and on mobile platforms such as Playhop, and it also has a Roblox release. Paid items, when they exist, are usually boosts and cosmetics rather than access to the game itself.

items.question: Why did my Break your Bones run end early?
items.answer: Most short runs come from a severe or critical break that removes your steering, followed by a fall out of the playable area and a void reset. Test ledges before you trust them, keep a healing item in reserve, and fight with solid geometry behind you so knockback cannot push you off the map.
